items.headline: Albemarle Upgrade: Can Energy Storage Recharge Lithium's Leader?
items.snippet: Albemarle reports Q3 results on Nov. 4. Of 26 analysts, 16 rate Buy/Strong Buy, 8 Hold.

items.headline: Lithium's $100 Billion Supply Gap Hands Albemarle a Domestic Moat
items.snippet: In Q2 Energy Storage volumes rose 11% and realized price jumped 61% to $19.53/kg; segment adj. EBITDA surged 229% to $723M. Silver Peak is the only active US lithium mine; Kings Mountain restart permits sought.

items.headline: Albemarle Corporation(ALB) Zacks Company Report
items.snippet: Zacks Underperform: weaker Energy Storage volumes, falling lithium prices, supply-chain costs, weak cash conversion.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus keeps Buy; lithium price up ~67% YoY but below highs; supply/demand poised to improve into 2027.
